newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Light still mkt performer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Light still mkt performer.

text.p: -- Local investment bank Banco Icatu said in a report it has maintained its market performer rating on shares of Brazilian power distributor Light.
-- The bank also said it has raised inflation-adjusted earnings projections for the firm to $184 million from $150 million in 1996 and $421 million from $307 million in 1997.
-- Icatu added it has forecast earnings of $430 million for Light in 1998.
-- The bank cited Light's announcement of a downward revision of assets, withdrawing 753 million reais of its financial statement related to a special monetary correction.
-- "This measure represented a depreciation-related cost reduction of $38 million for the January-September 1996 results," it said.
-- The bank said that, while it has no effect on company valuation, the revision causes financial statements to become more representative of a company's economic situation.
-- Light shares ended at 363 reais Thursday on the Sao Paulo stock market.
